paper.title: Synthetic QA connectivity stress graph — 150 objects
paper.description: Deterministic replication of synthetic QA objects; cross-group edges test connectivity only, not mathematical validity.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Assumption 1.1
nodes.title: Independent centered observations
nodes.statement: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent with $\mathbb{E}X_i=0$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Assumption 1.2
nodes.title: Sub-Gaussian moment bound
nodes.statement: For every $t\in\mathbb{R}$ and every $i$, $\mathbb{E}e^{tX_i}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/2}$, where $\sigma>0$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Definition 1.3
nodes.title: Sample mean · 均值
nodes.statement: Define $\bar X_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Definition 1.4
nodes.title: Local confidence radius
nodes.statement: For $0<\delta<1$, let $r_n(\delta)=\sigma\sqrt{2\log(2/\delta)/n}$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Lemma 2.1
nodes.title: Moment bound for the mean
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\mathbb{E}e^{t\bar X_n}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/(2n)}$ for every real $t$.

evidence.excerpt: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\mathbb{E}e^{t\bar X_n}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/(2n)}$ for every real $t$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Lemma 2.2
nodes.title: Exponential Markov bound
nodes.statement: For $t>0$, $\Pr(Y\geq u)\leq e^{-tu}\mathbb{E}e^{tY}$ whenever the expectation exists.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Theorem 3.1
nodes.title: Concentration of the mean
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, for $u>0$, $$\Pr(|\bar X_n|\geq u)\leq 2e^{-nu^2/(2\sigma^2)}.$$

nodes.label: Group 0 · Theorem 3.2
nodes.title: Confidence radius
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\Pr(|\bar X_n|\geq r_n(\delta))\leq\delta$ for $0<\delta<1$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Proposition 3.3
nodes.title: Equivalent tail formulation
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\Pr(|\bar X_n|<u)\geq 1-2e^{-nu^2/(2\sigma^2)}$ for $u>0$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Corollary 3.4
nodes.title: Consistency
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2 for all $n$ with fixed $\sigma$, $\bar X_n\to0$ in probability.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Example 4.1
nodes.title: Gaussian observations
nodes.statement: Independent $N(0,\sigma^2)$ observations satisfy Assumptions 1.1–1.2.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Example 4.2
nodes.title: Random signs
nodes.statement: Independent uniform signs $X_i\in\{-1,1\}$ satisfy Assumption 1.2 with $\sigma=1$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Counterexample 4.3
nodes.title: Cauchy observations
nodes.statement: For standard Cauchy observations, the exponential moment does not exist for nonzero real $t$.

nodes.label: Group 0 · Claim 4.4
nodes.title: Deliberately disputed claim
nodes.statement: Every real-valued distribution satisfies a finite sub-Gaussian moment bound.

nodes.statement: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent with $\mathbb{E}X_i=0$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Assumption 1.2
nodes.title: Sub-Gaussian moment bound
nodes.statement: For every $t\in\mathbb{R}$ and every $i$, $\mathbb{E}e^{tX_i}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/2}$, where $\sigma>0$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Definition 1.3
nodes.title: Sample mean · 均值
nodes.statement: Define $\bar X_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Definition 1.4
nodes.title: Local confidence radius
nodes.statement: For $0<\delta<1$, let $r_n(\delta)=\sigma\sqrt{2\log(2/\delta)/n}$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Lemma 2.1
nodes.title: Moment bound for the mean
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\mathbb{E}e^{t\bar X_n}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/(2n)}$ for every real $t$.

evidence.excerpt: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\mathbb{E}e^{t\bar X_n}\leq e^{\sigma^2t^2/(2n)}$ for every real $t$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Lemma 2.2
nodes.title: Exponential Markov bound
nodes.statement: For $t>0$, $\Pr(Y\geq u)\leq e^{-tu}\mathbb{E}e^{tY}$ whenever the expectation exists.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Theorem 3.1
nodes.title: Concentration of the mean
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, for $u>0$, $$\Pr(|\bar X_n|\geq u)\leq 2e^{-nu^2/(2\sigma^2)}.$$

nodes.label: Group 9 · Theorem 3.2
nodes.title: Confidence radius
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\Pr(|\bar X_n|\geq r_n(\delta))\leq\delta$ for $0<\delta<1$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Proposition 3.3
nodes.title: Equivalent tail formulation
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2, $\Pr(|\bar X_n|<u)\geq 1-2e^{-nu^2/(2\sigma^2)}$ for $u>0$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Corollary 3.4
nodes.title: Consistency
nodes.statement: Under Assumptions 1.1–1.2 for all $n$ with fixed $\sigma$, $\bar X_n\to0$ in probability.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Example 4.1
nodes.title: Gaussian observations
nodes.statement: Independent $N(0,\sigma^2)$ observations satisfy Assumptions 1.1–1.2.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Example 4.2
nodes.title: Random signs
nodes.statement: Independent uniform signs $X_i\in\{-1,1\}$ satisfy Assumption 1.2 with $\sigma=1$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Counterexample 4.3
nodes.title: Cauchy observations
nodes.statement: For standard Cauchy observations, the exponential moment does not exist for nonzero real $t$.

nodes.label: Group 9 · Claim 4.4
nodes.title: Deliberately disputed claim
nodes.statement: Every real-valued distribution satisfies a finite sub-Gaussian moment bound.

nodes.title: Standalone 0
